brief_rationale: The trajectory contains a serious medication/allergy reconciliation error: the doctor definitively labeled an ambiguous local reaction as contact dermatitis and an allergy history despite the family being unable to identify the culprit. Although later instructions appropriately deferred wound care to the treating team and established executable follow-up and escalation, they do not erase that serious in-chain commission. Additional minor gaps included failure to cover limb ischemia warning signs, explain the VTE/preoperative-result boundaries, and discuss surgery versus conservative care, so the deterministic grade is 1.

closure_assessment.explanation: By the end of the bounded episode, the family had a workable wound-center follow-up plan, avoidance of old topical medications, and clear emergency escalation instructions. The final family update reported adherence and improvement without new red flags; the earlier serious diagnostic overclaim remains a grading error but did not leave the terminal plan unsafe.
